item.title: 2026.08.28.fa09683
item.description:
• Fixed — the Sessions tab now loads. Once the gateway had recorded more than a handful of sessions, its reply outgrew the control channel's send buffer and was silently cut off, so the tab sat on "Loading sessions…" forever. Replies of any size now arrive intact — and while a load is still in flight the tab says so, instead of misreporting the service as too old to report sessions.
  • Fixed — "Refresh usage now" no longer sticks greyed out. If the background service was updated or restarted in the middle of a refresh, the button could latch disabled for the rest of the session. It now re-reads the real state on every refresh and recovers on its own.
  • Fixed — the background service reloads more reliably. Reinstalling or reloading the launch agent could fail with a transient "Bootstrap failed: 5" because macOS tears the old job down asynchronously; tokenbank now waits for the old job to clear before starting the new one.

item.title: 2026.08.28.5a55651
item.description:
• The gateway is here. tokenbank can now run as a local gateway for Claude Code and other Anthropic clients: point them at it and it spreads your work across the logins you've chosen to pool, so no single account's 5-hour or weekly limit is the thing that stops you. Turn it on in the Gateway tab — "Configure this Mac" wires up the environment for you, and un-wires it again in one click.
  • You can see exactly where your work is going. A new Sessions tab shows which account served which conversation; the menu-bar percentage now tracks the pool — the accounts that actually serve traffic — instead of the one login the gateway never routes to; and every response is recorded per account and per client in the ledger, priced as it's read.
  • Safe by design. Each account keeps part of its 5-hour window and its credits in reserve, so a background agent can't spend you out of your own session; the 1-hour prompt-cache discount is kept intact end to end; a provider overload no longer burns through every consented account looking for room; and a rejected request names the real Anthropic account instead of an anonymous slot.

item.title: 2026.08.13.597a127
item.description:
• A maxed-out window now tells you when it frees up. A usage row at 100% used to read "maxed" where every other row shows a countdown — but the red bar and the red "100%" already say it's maxed, and the one thing you actually want at that point is when you can work again. Every row now shows "resets in 3h 12m". Suggested by The Antwerper Duke.
  • Fixed — a reset time that has just passed no longer reads "resets in expired". It now says "resetting…" until the next poll picks up the new window.

item.title: 2026.08.04.d513aad
item.description:
• Switching accounts now warns you when a Claude session is running. Promoting a different login replaces the shared credential the claude CLI uses — if a session is live, that can log it out and force a re-login. tokenbank now asks first ("A Claude session is running … switch anyway?") so you don't rotate a running session's login by accident.
  • Duplicate-login detection. If two saved accounts end up on the same login (identical token), each row now shows "Shares a login with …" — a heads-up to re-link one, since refreshing or switching one of a shared pair silently killed the other.

item.title: 2026.08.03.721176a
item.description: • Fixed — the background service could crash-loop and get stuck on "not running". If one of your logins needed re-login, a status line the service wrote to its log at startup could crash it the instant it launched — so the menu bar showed "not running" even though nothing else was wrong, and it couldn't recover on its own. Fixed at the root; the service now stays up and simply notes the failing account.

item.title: 2026.08.03.493ea3c
item.description: • Fixed — the menu bar no longer gets stuck on "not running" after sleep. Waking your Mac (opening the lid after a commute) could leave tokenbank showing the daemon as down even though it was running fine. It now reconnects the moment you wake.

item.title: 2026.08.03.8892ee3
item.description:
• New — automatic updates, if you want them. Settings ▸ Maintenance has an "Install updates automatically" toggle: turn it on and tokenbank downloads and installs updates in the background; off (the default) it asks you first.
  • The menu-bar % tracks your 5-hour window. It now shows the 5-hour usage — the limit you'll hit first — instead of whichever window happened to be highest.
  • Settings tidied — the Claude engine status (version/path) moved to the Diagnostics tab, alongside the connection and daemon health.

item.title: 2026.07.28.90531f5
item.description:
• Fixed — the same login in two organizations no longer mixes up its usage. If you imported an account under two organizations (same email, different org), tokenbank could show one org's numbers for the other and even overwrite the saved login. It now tells them apart by organization, so each shows — and keeps — its own. Spotted by The Antwerper Duke.
  • Accounts show their organization. Each row now lists the organization under the email, so two logins that share an email are easy to tell apart at a glance.
  • Lighter background helper. tokenbank's daemon is now a native binary — less memory, same features. Nothing to do; it updates in place.
